headline: Geneva Extends Autonomous-Weapons Talks to 2028
deck: The agreement keeps work on a possible accord moving without a commitment to binding rules.
body: Scores of countries agreed to elaborate a possible accord on lethal autonomous weapons systems by 2028, Associated Press reported. [E3] They did not commit to binding rules. [E4]

Associated Press described the Geneva outcome as a softened agreement extending discussions for two more years. [E2] Reuters reported that the CCW compromise would continue work on lethal autonomous weapons toward 2028 without a legally binding instrument. [E1]
